title: Wang's belongings removed from his house after death
summary: Greg Bishop tells of Wang's belongings removed from his house after death, about unspecified at Eric Wang's house, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Yeah, I think they came also came and uh took a bunch of stuff out of his house when he died.

plain: Greg Bishop, a writer about UFO lore, spoke on Jesse Michels's podcast about a man named Eric Henry Wang. Bishop says he believes that when Wang died, people came and took a lot of things out of his house. He tells it as a hint that someone wanted whatever Wang had kept.
